title: EGA projective-bundle projectivity
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes. In the EGA/Illusie--Laszlo--Orgogozo convention, $f$ is *projective in the projective-bundle sense* if, for some quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module $\mathcal E$ of finite type [pqf-def-coherent], $X$ is isomorphic over $S$ to a closed subscheme of the projective bundle $\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E)=\operatorname{Proj}_S(\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal E)$, the relative Proj [def-nagata-relative-proj] of the quasi-coherent symmetric algebra [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra] with its grading by symmetric degree [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-graded], with $f$ the resulting structure morphism. This is the projective-bundle convention distinguished from the finite-projective-space (H-projective) convention [def-kun-projective].
